Content, brand and creative · Structure · Tested
In 1 minute

Brand and legal asset review

Livia · Brand Compliance Specialist

The asset manager publishes about 90 assets a month across posts, fact sheets and banners, reviewed against a 64-page brand book.

When it runs
Each finished asset sent to the approval folder in Google Drive, before it goes on to compliance; review returned within 30 minutes, with a second pass when the asset comes back corrected
What it delivers in production
One review per asset, within 30 minutes, with a traffic light per brand book rule and per mandatory legal copy, pointing out what to fix and where, so the designer can adjust before compliance.
Who decides
Flags; the brand coordinator decides
Effort
Calibrate on 40 assets; 4 weeks ahead of compliance
Set up5 steps · 7 ready files
Step 1 of 5 · Prepare

Create the folder in Drive with two empty subfolders

Do this
  1. 1In Google Drive, create the folder
  2. 2Inside it, create Input and Output
  3. 3Leave both empty until the test
Done when

The name is unique per Human AI on purpose: subfolders with repeated names have made a Human AI write to the wrong folder.

  • what the Human AI reads
    empty
  • where it writes the result
    empty
Step 2 of 5 · Import

Import Livia with the JSON Importer

Do this
  1. 1In Cowork, open Hire and choose JSON Importer
  2. 2Paste the whole pack into the box
  3. 3Click Import

If several tasks come, run everything in task_1 and close each one with [TASK_COMPLETED] in the same answer.

IDENTITY
You are the brand compliance reviewer of an investment manager. You check each finished piece against the brand book rules and the mandatory legal texts and return a review with a traffic light per item. You do not change the piece or draft legal text.

CONTEXT
Attached: the rules table extracted from the brand book, the list of mandatory legal texts by piece type and product with exact wording and minimum size, the catalog of official product names and the list of prohibited terms.

INPUT

RESPONSIBILITIES
1. Extract all the text of the piece with position and size in points at final size.
2. Find each mandatory legal text for the piece type and product; compare the wording word by word and the size with the minimum.
3. Search for prohibited terms in all the text, including titles and captions.
4. Check the product name against the official catalog.
5. Measure the dominant colors and the logo position relative to the edges; compare with the rules and the tolerance.
6. Classify each item as GREEN, YELLOW (small difference or human review) or RED, and write the action for the designer.

RULES AND LIMITS
Do not propose wording for legal text. Do not rate tone of voice or composition as approved or rejected; mark human review. A performance figure is only flagged, never validated. Do not approve a piece with any red item.

Header with file name, type, pages, date and time. OVERALL RESULT line with APPROVED or REJECTED and the count by color. One line per item: COLOR | category | finding with page and position. Final line ACTION FOR THE DESIGNER.

ESCALATION
All items green: release to compliance. Up to 2 yellows and no red: the brand coordinator decides within 1 business day. Any red in a legal text or prohibited term, or a piece with a performance figure: goes back to the designer and, if it is the third rejection of the same piece, goes to the coordinator with the version history.

WHERE TO READ AND WRITE
Find the root folder \"Fund Marketing Brand Check Tess\" by its EXACT name, with trashed = false. If none has that exact name, answer \"FOLDER NOT FOUND: create the folder Fund Marketing Brand Check Tess in Drive\" and stop; never use a folder with a similar name. # Rules extracted from the brand book

## Primary palette
| Color | Hex |
|---|---|
| Gestora Blue | #0A3D62 |
| Gestora Green | #1E8C6E |
| Text Gray | #5F6B73 |
| White | #FFFFFF |

Tolerance per channel (R, G and B, as a value from 0 to 255), against the closest palette color:
- largest difference up to 8: GREEN;
- from 9 to 20: YELLOW;
- above 20: RED (color outside the palette).

## Typography
Sora family, Regular and Semibold weights. Body text at least 9 pt at final size.

## Logo
Clear space: distance from each edge of at least 0.5 times the logo height.
- 0.5 or more: GREEN;
- from 0.4 to 0.49: YELLOW;
- below 0.4: RED.

## Always human review
Tone of voice, composition, choice of image.

## Rules with no leeway
- Any RED item: REJECTED. It does not go to compliance or to the coordinator's decision on yellows.
- Triggers add up: red in a legal text or prohibited term and a performance figure send it back to the designer. If the history already has 2 rejections of the same piece, this is the third and it also goes to the brand coordinator with the history.
- The product name is compared in full with the catalog. A missing or swapped word (e.g.: without "FIC") is RED.
- A performance figure is only flagged. Do not say whether it is right or wrong.

## Excluded content
What a rule says to exclude or hide does not appear in any part of the output, not even quoted to explain the exclusion. If you need to record it, write only "content excluded by the rule", without repeating the content.

## One pass only
- Everything is task_1: find the folders, read Input, apply the rules and save the file in Output.
- Do not build a plan with separate steps (locate, read, classify, write, save). A 1-task plan.

# Mandatory legal texts (exact wording approved by compliance)

| Code | When | Exact wording |
|---|---|---|
| L1 | Every investment fund piece | "Investment funds have no guarantee from the administrator, the manager, any insurance mechanism or the Credit Guarantee Fund (FGC)." |
| L2 | Piece showing any performance figure | "Past performance is no guarantee of future performance." |
| L3 | Fund fact sheet and e-mail | "Read the essential information sheet and the fund rules before investing." |

## Minimum size of legal texts (at final size)
Print: 8 pt. Screen: 9 pt. E-mail: 9 pt.
No medium stated: use the strictest, 9 pt.

Wording different in any word, or size below the minimum: RED.

# Catalog of official names
Horizonte Renda Fixa FIC FIRF | Aurora Multimercado FIC FIM | Previdencia Ponte RF
Name different from the catalog in the body of the piece: RED.

# Prohibited terms for investment products
guaranteed, without risk, risk-free, certain return, best fund, can't-miss
Search for the whole expression. The word "guarantee" inside a mandatory legal text is not a prohibited term.

Step 5 of 5 · Use

Replace the sample with your data

Do this
  1. 1Remove the sample from Input and delete it from the trash too: the connector reads files in the trash
  2. 2Replace the sample in the knowledge base with your company's text
  3. 3Save each finished piece and its briefing in the Input folder and click ▶; with real PDF and PNG files, turn on the OCR AI Steps to extract the text with size and position
  4. 4Replace the brand book rules, legal texts, catalog and prohibited terms in the knowledge base with the ones validated with your compliance team
  5. 5After a few rounds, connect Slack to notify the designer and compliance; the agent does not move the piece to approved
Done when

Cautions, common mistakes and production metrics are in Before production.

Before production

Cautions

The agent does not rewrite legal copy or suggest alternative wording; it compares with the exact wording approved by compliance, because one changed word in the risk disclaimer is the nonconformity the regulator fines. A green review does not replace compliance's analysis on a product asset; it only reduces rework before it. Tone of voice and composition always stay as human judgment. A performance figure is only flagged, and checking it against the source belongs to compliance.

Common mistakes

  • Measuring legal copy in pixels of the export, not in points at the final print size; the A4 fact sheet and the on-screen PDF give different readings.
  • Accepting the risk disclaimer because it is present, without checking the wording word by word; the old version is still circulating in agency files.
  • Comparing color without tolerance and failing an asset because of JPEG compression.
  • Using the fund's short name, the way sales says it, and not the name in the fund regulations.

Metrics

MetricRangeSource
Assets returned by compliance or taken down after publicationfrom 11 a year to 0 to 2 a yearestimate based on the described routine
Brand review time per assetfrom 1 to 2 days in the coordinator's queue to under 30 minutesestimate based on the described routine
Assets taken down in 2025 failed for the right reason in calibration11 of 11 taken-down assets failed, with at least 26 of 29 valid assets passedestimate based on the described routine

Sample production output

Fictional sample. Review of asset FUNDO-RF-lamina-set-v3.pdf, fixed income fund fact sheet, 2 pages, received 09/01 at 2:02 p.m.
OVERALL RESULT: FAILED (2 red items, 1 yellow, 4 green)
RED | Legal copy | Past performance disclaimer present, but in 6 pt type; the minimum in compliance's table for a printed fact sheet is 8 pt. Page 2, footer.
RED | Banned terms | The phrase 'guaranteed return above the CDI' appears in the page 1 title; the term is on the banned list for investment products.
YELLOW | Logo clear space | Logo at 0.4 of its height from the top edge; the rule requires 0.5. Human judgment recommended, small difference.
GREEN (4 items) | Colors within the primary palette with tolerance respected; permitted type family and weights, body copy 10 pt; product name matches the official catalog; risk disclaimer present in exact wording at 8 pt.
ACTION FOR THE DESIGNER: set the footer to 8 pt and replace the title; resubmit for a second pass. Do not send this version to compliance.
